## What changes, and for whom?

<!-- Start with the problem someone encounters today and what they can do after this change.
Use everyday language. If the change is internal, explain the effect on the people running or maintaining the service.
Link the relevant ticket (Fixes AB#… when applicable). -->

## Why these changes?

<!-- Connect each meaningful group of changes to the outcome or risk it addresses.
Every changed line should serve one of those reasons. Remove or split unrelated or redundant work;
don't narrate the diff line by line. -->

## How was it checked?

<!-- Give the check, its result, and the specific behavior or failure it proves.
Use an existing test when it already catches the same failure. Add another layer only when it catches a different one.
Separate checks actually run from checks still needed. Include the exact command and outcome for a required local smoke test. -->

## What should reviewers know?

<!-- If relevant, state rollout or merge order, remaining risks or decisions, and link screenshots for visible changes.
Omit this section when there's nothing to add. -->
